description.value:
House Jorasco teaches that sickness and injury haunt the living like ghosts, stealing their health and their years. You were taught to fight these scourges with both magic and medicine, and to use that skill in the service of others—while making sure you are always properly paid for it, so that House Jorasco itself stays healthy and long-lived. You might be a gentle healer with no stomach for fighting, or a cold specialist who knows exactly where to strike to disable or kill a foe.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Constitution, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.uAuEkkYCFK09c4rg]{Mark of Healing}

Skill Proficiencies: Medicine and Stealth

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulHerbalismK]{Herbalism Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHealersKit0]{Healer's Kit}, 25 GP; or (B) 50 GP
